title: Community wall polish: arrivals strip, Poll/Ask/Announce posts, ban from the wall, Space report queue

source.ref: Split from LIVE-2077 on 2026-11-03: the wall, composer, settings, moderation (pin/hide), What's Happening and About ship there; these pieces of the Circles handoff remain.

detail:
On /spaces/[slug]/community: the arrivals strip (new members this week), composer kinds Poll, Ask and Announce (Announce team-only), ban a person from the wall, and a Space report queue in /manage/community. New space.* capabilities for the team ladder if moderation needs to go below canEditProfile. Render at 390, 1280, 1440, 1920 and 2000 before merge.

2026-11-09: shipped. Arrivals strip (space_memberships this week) above the wall composer with Wave hello; composer kinds Poll, Ask and Announce (Announce for the Space team, enforced by the posts INSERT policy); space_wall_bans with a ban from each post row and a Banned list; a Reports section in /manage/community for pending reports on the wall's posts (hide and close, or dismiss). New capability canModerateWall (owner, admin, moderator) matches private.can_moderate_space_wall. Migration 20270346030000_space_wall_bans_and_kinds.sql.
